name: Cyber Evolution
detailed_description:
Every match begins with an Evolution—an upgrade that defines your opening strategy. From there, round winners push forward while the defeated gain new evolutions to shift momentum. Adapt, evolve, and counter your opponents with powerful synergies and game-changing abilities. Whether you build into a resilient powerhouse, tanky juggernaut, a stealthy assassin, or a bullet-blasting chaos machine—the choice is yours.

Key Features

  • Round-Based Multiplayer: Compete in short, intense rounds where the winner advances closer to match victory and the loser gets the chance to evolve for the next battle.

  • Endless Build Variety: Choose from hundreds of unique upgrade combinations to evolve your character with new powers, enhanced projectiles, movement tech, and more.

  • Physics-Driven Combat: Projectiles matter. Dodge, reflect, bounce, or snipe—every shot is physical, every impact counts.

  • Sci-Fi Aesthetic: Enter a high-tech world of glowing arenas, futuristic weapons, and cybernetic characters.

  • Skill Wins Rounds: No grind, no pay-to-win. Victory comes from adaptability, quick thinking, and precise aim.

  • LAN or Online Play: Host games with friends or battle it out online. No live service required.

Evolve each round. Master the chaos. Forge your legend in Cyber Evolution.

short_description: Cyber Evolution is a fast paced, third-person multiplayer shooter where every round is a chance to evolve, adapt, and outplay your opponents. Dive into a neon-soaked cyber arena where physics-based projectiles, skill-based combat, and ever-evolving upgrades create endless variety.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and up
  • Processor: any 4 core processor and up
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1080 (or equivalent) and up.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 4th Gen I7(or equivalent) and up
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2080 (or equivalent) and up.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
